{{Top|leg}}
The '''Warchigade Trade Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] that passed through the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Toblain sector/Legends|Toblain sector]].<ref name="Stock Ships">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

It was often preyed upon by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]], such as when [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Aricos Dreleene]] was captured aboard his ship, the [[Almost Authentic|''First Edition'']].<ref name="Stock Ships" />
